title: Separate Sign Up and Log In buttons on the authentication screen

requirements.text: Update the unauthenticated landing screen UI to show two distinct primary actions—one button labeled "Sign Up" and a second button labeled "Log In"—instead of the single combined "Sign Up / Log In" button.

quotes: there should be different button for signup and login.

acceptanceCriteria: On the LoginScreen, two separate buttons are visible: "Sign Up" and "Log In".
The previous combined button label "Sign Up / Log In" is no longer shown.
Both buttons initiate the existing Internet Identity authentication flow (no backend changes required).

requirements.text: Ensure loading/disabled behavior is correct when authentication is in progress: when a user clicks either "Sign Up" or "Log In", both buttons are disabled while `loginStatus === 'logging-in'`, and the UI provides clear feedback that a connection is in progress.

quotes: there should be different button for signup and login.

acceptanceCriteria: While `loginStatus === 'logging-in'`, both buttons are disabled to prevent duplicate login attempts.
During the logging-in state, the UI shows a "Connecting..." loading state (spinner + text) on the auth CTA area.
When login completes or errors, buttons return to enabled state accordingly.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or other frontend immutablePaths.
Keep the existing Internet Identity authentication mechanism; do not introduce third-party auth providers.
nonGoals: Changing backend signup/login logic or adding separate backend endpoints for signup vs login.
Adding username/password authentication (the app continues to use Internet Identity).
